description: Read back the questions and answers already recorded in a notebook, newest first. RPC-backed (no browser). NotebookLM exposes only the most recent conversation, which is what you get unless you pass `conversation_id`.

conversation_id.description: A specific conversation. Defaults to the most recent one.

limit.description: Maximum turns to return, newest first. Default 20.

name: get_chat_history

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
